title: The database refuses two live bookings whose times overlap, not only two that start at the same instant

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: the race guard is a unique index on (space_id, starts_at) where status in (confirmed, pending). Overlap with different starts is checked only in application code after a read, so two bookers racing (a 60 minute service at 10:00 and a 30 minute one at 10:30, or any buffered pair) both pass and both insert. Fix: btree_gist plus an exclusion constraint on (space_id with =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) with &&) for live statuses, with the insert error mapped to the existing 'just taken' message. Buffers stay an app rule.

DONE 2026-11-23: migration 20270346280000_space_bookings_no_overlap.sql adds btree_gist and the exclusion constraint space_bookings_no_overlap on (space_id =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) &&, chain_id <>) for confirmed and pending bookings, with a pgTAP test. chain_id (set by a before-insert trigger) is a booking's own id or the chain of the booking it was rescheduled from, so a reschedule may overlap the booking it replaces while that one is still live (the app inserts the new booking before it cancels the old). The insert error already reads as 'That time was just taken. Pick another.' Buffers stay an app rule.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
